title: Privacy policy
draft: Draft: not reviewed by a lawyer yet.
paragraphs: [LEGAL NAME], [ADDRESS], collects your email address, the languages of your calls, your role, Mac type, macOS version, call apps, page language and the time of your request.

We use this information to send beta invitations through [EMAIL SERVICE] and decide what to build. We process it with your consent. You can withdraw consent by emailing [CONTACT EMAIL]. We delete your data on request and when the beta ends.
The site sets no analytics or advertising cookies. GitHub Pages processes IP addresses in its server logs. Cloudflare Turnstile protects the signup form.
DialogTrack processes recordings on your Mac. This website never receives your recordings or transcripts.
